  "evidence_ids": ["E1.1"],
  "reasons": [
    "When a Rs 100 debenture is issued at Rs 110, the excess of Rs 10 represents premium on issue.",
    "According to NCERT Accounting for Debentures, this premium is credited to the Securities Premium Reserve account and presented under the sub-head Reserves and Surplus (or Reserves and Surpluses)."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Debentures",
  "syllabus_topic": "Issue of Debentures at Premium",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "The nominal value is Rs 100 and issue price is Rs 110 per debenture.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Debenture premium is credited to Securities Premium Reserve A/c and shown under Reserves and Surpluses in the balance sheet.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": ["E1.1"]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "strongest_reading": "Debentures A/c receives only the nominal face value of debentures, not the issue premium.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "Issue premium is a capital receipt and cannot be credited to Statement of Profit and Loss as other income.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "Debentures represent debt finance, so premium on their issue is never credited to Share Capital A/c.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [],
  "style_notes": [],

    "exemplar_ids_compared": ["cuet2024-accountancy-bookA-q6", "cuet2024-accountancy-bookA-q14"]
  },
  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Debentures A/c; shown under Non-current liabilities as long-term borrowings",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount of premium is credited to Securities Premium Reserve account and is shown on the liabilities side of the balance sheet under the head “Reserves and Surpluses”.",
      "reason": "Debentures account is credited with nominal value, whereas the premium is credited to Securities Premium Reserve."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount of premium is credited to Securities Premium Reserve account and is shown on the liabilities side of the balance sheet under the head “Reserves and Surpluses”.",
      "reason": "Matches the textbook treatment for issue of debentures at premium."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Statement of Profit and Loss; shown as other income",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount of premium is credited to Securities Premium Reserve account and is shown on the liabilities side of the balance sheet under the head “Reserves and Surpluses”.",
      "reason": "Debenture premium is a capital receipt credited to Securities Premium Reserve, not revenue income."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Share Capital A/c; shown under Share Capital in equity",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount of premium is credited to Securities Premium Reserve account and is shown on the liabilities side of the balance sheet under the head “Reserves and Surpluses”.",
      "reason": "Debentures are debt instruments and have no relation to Share Capital account."
    }
  ]
